description.value: White Elephant Thai is a locally owned Thai restaurant in Parksville serving a broad menu of classic Thai dishes including Pad Thai, curries, satay, and fresh salad rolls. The menu accommodates multiple dietary preferences with dedicated tofu and vegetable options across nearly every category. For cyclists touring the east coast of Vancouver Island, it offers a full sit-down meal in a town well-positioned along the Island's main cycling corridors.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the business is active and open, displaying a full menu and contact details matching the OSM address (144 Weld Street, Parksville, BC). The website provides a phone number (250-586-6611) absent from OSM. Menu listings explicitly include tofu and vegetable options throughout, confirming vegetarian availability. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, washrooms, or most other amenities.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website lists 250-586-6611, which has been used as the top-level phone value.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active Thai restaurant in Parksville with a confirmed website, full menu, and matching address. A useful dining stop for touring cyclists on Vancouver Island's east coast.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists multiple vegetarian items including Crispy Tofu, vegetable spring rolls, salad rolls with tofu, and noodle/fried rice dishes offered with 'vegetables & tofu' as a protein choice

wow_evidence: locally owned Thai restaurant in Parksville
